title: rpg-classic encounter
description: One encounter composition: which enemies appear, how many, and what the whole battle pays out. This projects onto ONE element of the array that eve.rpg.EncounterCatalogue.replaceFromJsonStrict consumes; tools/build_encounters.py concatenates every encounter document into that array. The engine loader is strict AND atomic: it rejects unknown fields outright and replaces the whole catalogue or nothing (EncounterCatalogue.cpp:63-176), so a single malformed encounter would silently cost the project every other encounter — which is why this is a validated content kind rather than a hand-written JSON blob. Members name an enemy id plus a count instead of restating stats: attack/defense/maxHp/speed belong to the enemy document and exactly one of them is the authority. Two engine constraints the schema cannot express are enforced by the semantic gate: xpReward must be strictly positive, and the same enemy may not appear twice in one encounter (the projection derives member ids from the enemy id, so a repeat would collide in a loader that rejects duplicate member ids).
